import os

from hamana.connector.db.oracle import OracleConnector

# build a standalone configuration object (no shortcut)
config = OracleConnector.create_config(
    user="my_user",
    password=os.environ["ORACLE_PASSWORD"],
    host="my_host",
    service="my_service",
)

# construct the connector from the configuration object
connector = OracleConnector(config)

# execute the query
result_query = connector.execute("SELECT sysdate FROM dual")

print(result_query.result)
